name: Camp of the Latzimestal
title: Camp of the Latzimestal
summary: Three tents near the Ithaenc Cathedral where the Dericost forces (Anadil, Asmolum, Rytheran, Aerfalle, Elleina) gathered before the battle against Bael'Zharon (acpedia). In the kit, three 11.5 m octagonal hide tents (z 144-152) step down a jungle slope 100-170 m south of the cathedral, with an exploration marker and wandering skeletons.

site.name: Camp of the Latzimestal
site.notes: The gazetteer entry for the camp is only a map @tele; the nearest exact outdoor teleport (cathedral-ruins) is 129 m north inside the cathedral, so a derived @teleloc on the open ground between the three tents is used (ground z 150.25, nearest tent 15.6 m).

shots.standingOrder: Look straight down on the first of the three Latzimestal tents and climb vertically 46 m, turning slowly, until the camp's tents lie small in their jungle clearing; nothing above the lens.
shots.notes: Top-down rise from 12 m to 58 m over the first of the three Latzimestal hide tents, pitched -88 and turning 40 degrees. The camp shrinks into its jungle clearing on the slope below the cathedral. Peak 6.6 m/s.
